responsibility: Implements the language-independent tree conversion utilities that front ends and generic folding code use to change expressions between GCC scalar and vector types. It owns the detailed rules for building and optionally folding conversions to integer, pointer, real, complex, fixed-point, and vector types, preserves source-location wrappers on folded constants, emits diagnostics for invalid conversions, and includes selftests for key conversion behavior.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual language-independent tree conversion routines, with folding, diagnostics, and selftests for pointer, integer, real, complex, fixed-point, and vector conversions; unlike gcc/convert.h, which only exposes the callable conversion entry points and inline no-fold wrappers.
